subject: Healthly: Temporary retain request for logs/backups — DPA addendum & subprocessor attestation
messages:
From: Gina Park <gina@healthly.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@healthly.io
Date: 2029-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Temporary retain of logs/backups for upcoming compliance review

Hi Neha,

We have a scheduled compliance review with our auditor on June 18–20 and need to request a temporary retain on a subset of account and application logs that relate to Healthly's integration with Redwood. Specifically:
- Platform logs (auth, admin actions) and backup snapshots covering 2029-04-01 to 2029-05-20
- Any KV/cache snapshots tied to session IDs for the same window

We understand Redwood's standard backup purge cadence, but this audit requires us to preserve the materials for 90 days from today while the review is ongoing and potential evidence requests are processed. We also need an attestation that any subprocessors (Acme Cloud) will not purge those snapshots during that hold and that a DPA addendum covering temporary retention will be signed.

Attached: Healthly_Audit_Request_202905.pdf (summary of audit scope).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can pause purge jobs for the specified snapshots and coordinate a subprocessor attestation? If there are costs or SLAs to escalate, flag them and we can route through procurement.

Thanks,

Gina Park
Head of Compliance | Healthly
Phone: +1 415 555 0127

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Gina Park <gina@healthly.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retain of logs/backups for upcoming compliance review

Hi Gina — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. Looping in Legal (Kimberly), Ops (Marissa) and Infra (Avery) to scope the ask. A couple quick clarifying questions before we lock the hold plan:

1) Confirm the exact object identifiers or account IDs for the snapshots you want preserved (we can scope by app-id or by backup job id).
2) Is Healthly requesting a full 90-day hold or an initial 30/60-day hold with the option to extend after the auditor's initial pass?
3) Do you require Immutable snapshots (write-once) or is a soft-hold on purge jobs sufficient?

Operationally, our standard approach is to:
- Create an immutable snapshot copy if legal requires chain-of-custody evidence
- Pause scheduled purge jobs for the snapshot IDs in question
- Request attestation from Acme Cloud to ensure subprocessor retention flags are set

I've attached a short template for temporary-retain requests that helps us collect the identifiers and legal language: temp_retain_template.docx (fill the top section and we'll spin up the hold). If Healthly needs the full 90 days we may need the DPA addendum signed first; if 30 days is acceptable we can proceed on an ops-only hold in most cases.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Gina Park <gina@healthly.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@healthly.io
Date: 2029-05-20T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retain of logs/backups for upcoming compliance review

Neha — thanks. We filled the template inline below (copied from temp_retain_template.docx):
- Account IDs: healthly-prod-1822, healthly-int-ops-1822
- Snapshot IDs / Job IDs: bk-20290501-a1, bk-20290508-b3, bk-20290515-c7
- Data types: auth logs, admin-change logs, nightly backups of DB shards 4–6, KV snapshots for session namespace "hl_session"
- Requested hold duration: 90 days from 2029-05-20 (we can agree to a review at 30 and 60 days)
- Evidence needs: chain-of-custody digest + export .tar.gz on request

We will start the internal approval for a DPA addendum but need Redwood to confirm ops steps so we can schedule the auditor call. The subprocessor attestation from Acme is critical — please let us know who is the Acme contact.

Gina

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Gina Park <gina@healthly.io>
Date: 2029-05-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Temporary retain of logs/backups for upcoming compliance review

Team — quick legal note and proposed next steps.

1) DPA addendum: Healthly's ask for a 90-day retain requires a simple addendum. I've prepared redlines and attached DPA_addendum_redlines.pdf. We should send via DocuSign for signature; adding Healthly legal to the envelope will expedite.

2) Evidence & chain-of-custody: If Healthly requires immutable copies, Ops should create a digest (SHA256 listing) and store an immutable copy in escrow. That preserves auditability.

3) Subprocessor engagement (Acme Cloud): we need Acme to confirm retention flagging on the named backups and to pause purge jobs that affect those snapshot IDs. Avery/Marissa please mark purge jobs J-421 and J-422 (these correspond to nightly snapshot pruning for shards 4–6) as paused and escalate to Acme with the job IDs.

4) Costs / billing: If Healthly elects immutable escrow copies or export packages, we should share a one-time engineering fee estimate. I'll draft a short statement to include in the DPA addendum about temporary hold costs.

I'll start the DocuSign envelope once we confirm the job IDs and Acme contact.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Gina Park <gina@healthly.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Acme Cloud <infra@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2029-05-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retain of logs/backups for upcoming compliance review — plan and action items

Thanks all — confirming the operational plan and owners below. Per the conversation and legal redlines, we will proceed with a 60-day operational hold effective 2029-05-22T00:00:00Z while Healthly completes the DPA addendum signature; Healthly requested 90 days, we will extend to 90 days upon signed addendum. Action items: 

1) Legal (Kimberly) — send DocuSign envelope to Healthly legal and include the draft cost clause. Link: https://docusign.com/redirect/abc123-healthly-dpa (please confirm when sent).

2) Infra (Avery) — create immutable snapshot copies for bk-20290501-a1, bk-20290508-b3, bk-20290515-c7 and generate SHA256 digest files; store digest in secure drive folder and mark snapshots as "retain".

3) Ops (Marissa) — pause purge jobs J-421 and J-422 for shards 4–6 and mark them on hold in the purge schedule. Confirm the pause and notify Acme (infra@acmecloud.com) to ensure subprocessor flags match.

4) Subprocessor (Acme Cloud) — please confirm by reply that you will not prune the named snapshot IDs and will set retention flags consistent with the hold. We also request a written attestation (email is fine) to be attached to the DPA addendum.

5) Healthly (Gina) — we will hold for 60 days while DPA is finalized; once addendum is signed we will extend to 90 days if required. If you need export packages (.tar.gz) we will estimate engineering time and share a one-time fee.

Attachments: DPA_addendum_redlines.pdf (legal redlines), temp_retain_template.docx (filled by Healthly), Healthly_Audit_Request_202905.pdf

I'll follow up in 24 hours with the Acme confirmation and snapshot digest locations.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
